title: Very useful
body: Been using this for many years.  Over time, it offers a very good view of trends.  The export function is a very nice detail.  As the app  is fully configurable it is possible to focus on things that are of particular interest.  Sometimes, I miss a third option in addition to the yes/no alternatives as everything is not black or white.  Maybe introduce a blue color?  But many thanks for a very good and useful app!

title: Super

title: A simple no-frills joy of an app
body: Tried several daily reminder/tracker apps, but this one was by far the best. From one screen I am able to easily update all my activities, write notes if I want to, and see how many days in a row I've managed to keep up my chain. More statistics, graphs, etc. available under the hood when I need them :-)
author: Nickstamatic

title: Best habit-building app!
body:
I have used Way of Life from June 2011 to November 2012 and found it to be an excellent tool to keep track of habits!

Way of Life helps me to monitor my habits with a minimal use of time, i.e. one minute per day for 15 habits.

Way of Life keeps its five-star rating by a wide margin after the two latest updated with notes and polish of the interface!
